heading, Tandem listens as you talk to create structured clinical documentation., level 1
heading, 1. Press start at the beginning of the visit, level 6
Tandem captures the conversation as it happens, so you can focus on the patient instead of the screen. No dictating or needing to remember details afterward.
heading, 2. Tandem creates a structured clinical note, level 6
Your consultation becomes a structured clinical note, ready to review when the visit ends. Notes, referrals, and follow-up documents are generated automatically.
heading, 3. Review, edit if needed, and transfer, level 6
Review and make any changes using your voice. When ready, send the note directly into your medical record system in one click.
heading, Automatically turn conversations into structured clinical notes, level 2
Tandem listens to the conversation, filters what's clinically relevant, and structures the note for your specialty.
end of link, Get a demo
heading, Clear audio, even in busy environments, level 6
Tandem captures conversations reliably in clinics, wards, and offices, turning speech into structured, high-quality notes.
heading, Speak any language in the room, level 6
Talk with patients in their language. Tandem transcribes instantly and generates the note in the language you choose.
heading, Edit notes with your voice, level 6
Tell Tandem what to add or change, and the note updates immediately. No clicking or typing.
heading, Create other documents from the same visit, level 2
Generate every required document, based on the same consultation.
heading, Referrals, sick notes, patient summaries, and more, level 6
Create any documents you need from the consultation. Generate them in one click, using the information already captured.
Tandem detects when a document is needed and lets you generate a draft immediately.
heading, Edit documents with your voice, level 6
Make changes by voice and see them applied immediately.

heading, “I am more satisfied with the quality of my consultations, and patients also seem to appreciate that extra attention and engagement from me. I am able to go home on time and Tandem has helped improve my work-life balance.”, level 3
end of link, Study on time saving
heading, Find the right codes during the visit, level 2
Relevant diagnosis and procedure codes appear alongside the note, drawn from the visit. Both the AI Scribe and the Coding Assistant are CE marked Class IIa under EU MDR.
heading, Relevant codes suggested from the consultation, level 6
Tandem identifies clinically relevant codes from the conversation and displays them next to your note.
heading, Supports commonly used coding standards, level 6
Access ICD-10, ICD-9, SNOMED CT, and KVÅ suggestions without switching screens or tools.
heading, Review and select with clinical control, level 6
You decide which codes to apply. Add, remove, or search for others at any time.
heading, MDR Class IIa certified, level 6
Tandem's Coding Assistant is independently assessed and certified under EU MDR as a Class IIa medical device.
heading, Saves directly to your medical record system, level 2
Send documentation straight to your medical record system in one click.
Send notes and documents straight to your medical record system without manual copying or re-entry.
heading, Works with how you already document, level 6
Tandem works within existing clinical processes so documentation becomes frictionless.
heading, Get custom integrations when required, level 6
Tandem connects to existing systems and builds new integrations to meet local requirements.
heading, “It’s absolutely amazing that there’s a programme that spells correctly, writes the entire note, and saves me 5 minutes of admin time per patient.”, level 3
heading, Tandem remembers how you write, level 2
Personalisation shapes every note to match your style, your clinic's conventions, and the words you use most. The longer you use Tandem, the more your notes sound like you wrote them.
heading, Note draft based on your former edits, level 6
When you adjust a note the same way more than once, Tandem suggests saving it as a Memory. Accept it, and every note that follows picks up the change.
heading, Your preferences, applied automatically, level 6
Save phrasing, structure, what to include or skip as Personal Memories. Tandem follows them on every note.
heading, Shared conventions across your clinic, level 6
Admins set Clinic Memories that apply across every clinician's notes. Coding standards, regulatory phrasing, house style.
heading, Special terms Tandem should recognise, level 6
Add words and abbreviations with Custom Vocabulary: drug brand names, specialty terminology, clinic-specific shorthand.
Designed to work across different specialities, locations, devices, and visit types.
heading, Document on the go, level 6
Use your phone to capture visits wherever you are, including home visits and outreach care.
heading, Switch between computer and phone seamlessly, level 6
Start a consultation on one device and continue on another without interruption.
heading, Built for remote and in-person care, level 6
Tandem supports remote consultations and face-to-face care with the same accuracy and workflow.
